calendly.description: Connect your business's Calendly: your AI agent offers and books its times, and appointments booked in Calendly show up in Whasalia.
calendly.notAvailable: The Calendly connection isn't enabled on the platform yet.
calendly.how1: Link each Calendly event type to a Whasalia service.
calendly.how2: Your AI agent offers Calendly's free times and books in the chat (or sends the link if your Calendly plan doesn't allow it).
calendly.how3: Appointments and cancellations made in Calendly are recorded in Whasalia.
calendly.connected: Calendly connected. Link each event type to a service.
calendly.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Calendly? Bookings already in Whasalia are kept.
calendly.bookingLink: By link (your Calendly plan doesn't allow API booking)
calendly.mapHelp: Choose which service each event type books. Those without a service aren't used in Whasalia.
calendly.noEventTypes: Your Calendly account has no event types.

errors.generic: We couldn't complete the action with Calendly. Try again.
errors.serviceTwice: A service can only be linked to one event type.

admin.title: Calendly
admin.subtitle: Platform OAuth app so each business can connect its Calendly.
admin.signingHelp: Calendly shows it when you create the app. Without it, appointments made in Calendly are checked every 5 minutes instead of arriving instantly.
admin.removeConfirm: Remove the Calendly credentials? Connected businesses will stop syncing.
admin.redirectHelp: Paste it in the Calendly app as the Redirect URI.
admin.webhookHelp: Whasalia registers it on each connected account.
admin.setup1: Go to developer.calendly.com and create an OAuth application (Web type, Production environment).
admin.setup3: Copy the Client ID, Client secret and Webhook signing key Calendly shows.
